title: Smoke doc 1
content: The Collegian is the bi-weekly official student publication of Houston Baptist University in Houston, Texas. It was founded in 1963 as a newsletter, and adopted the newspaper format in 1990. Several private institutions of higher learning are located within the city, including Rice University and Houston Baptist University.

content: Hertfordshire is the county immediately north of London and is part of the East of England region. The East of England is one of nine official regions of England at the first level of NUTS for statistical purposes. It was created in 1994 and was adopted for statistics from 1999.
